parts.question: Current AX-17 renal guidance in Germany?

result.answer: For normal renal function (eGFR >=90), the starting dose is 50 mg OD, maximum is 100 mg/day, and monitoring is routine [E2]. For mild renal impairment (eGFR 60-89), the starting dose is 50 mg OD, maximum is 100 mg/day, and monitoring is routine [E2]. For moderate renal impairment (eGFR 30-59), the starting dose is 25 mg once daily, maximum is 50 mg/day, and monitoring is to recheck 2-4 weeks [E1, E2, E3]. For severe renal impairment (eGFR 15-29), the starting dose requires specialist review, maximum is 25 mg/day, and monitoring is enhanced [E2].
